3namespace Faker\Calculator;
4
5/**
6 * Utility class for validating EAN-8 and EAN-13 numbers
7 */
8class Ean
9{
10    /**
11     * @var string EAN validation pattern
12     */
13    public const PATTERN = '/^(?:\d{8}|\d{13})$/';
14
15    /**
16     * Computes the checksum of an EAN number.
17     *
18     * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Article_Number
19     *
20     * @return int
21     */
22    public static function checksum(string $digits)
23    {
24        $sequence = (strlen($digits) + 1) === 8 ? [3, 1] : [1, 3];
25        $sums = 0;
26
27        foreach (str_split($digits) as $n => $digit) {
28            $sums += ((int) $digit) * $sequence[$n % 2];
29        }
30
31        return (10 - $sums % 10) % 10;
32    }
33
34    /**
35     * Checks whether the provided number is an EAN compliant number and that
36     * the checksum is correct.
37     *
38     * @param string $ean An EAN number
39     *
40     * @return bool
41     */
42    public static function isValid(string $ean)
43    {
44        if (!preg_match(self::PATTERN, $ean)) {
45            return false;
46        }
47
48        return self::checksum(substr($ean, 0, -1)) === (int) substr($ean, -1);
49    }
50}
